// Holds comment markers as content.
public class Literals
{
    private string a = "// not a comment";
    private string b = @"/* not a comment */";
    private string c = $"{1} // not a comment in an interpolated string";
    private char d = '/';
    private string e = """
        // not a comment in a raw string
        """;
    private string f = @"a "" // not a comment after an escaped quote";
}
